contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ (D N MAGNEN ; R/ SALVS DD NN AVG ET CAES

Copper alloy Roman nummus of Magnentius (350-353 AD), minted in Trier 352-353 AD. obv legend: (D N MAGNEN - TIVS P F AVG) obv type: bare-headed, draped and cuirassed right. rev legend: SALVS DD NN AVG ET CAES rev type: large Chi-Rho, between Alpha and Omega. Finder's number 3
